plan.title: Vendors see best price in price-based auction

steps.note: Start a single-stage event so the auction strategy can be configured.
Configure a live price-based auction, where the best price should be exposed to vendors.
Apply the first available auction template.
Add one item for the vendor bids.
Invite two vendors so the auction has competing bids and a current best price.
Publish the auction so vendors can bid.
Verify the auction reached a real published project page.
Verify the first vendor's bid was accepted.
Verify the second vendor's bid was accepted.
Open the invited vendor's separate supplier-portal session.
Open the live auction's pricing round as the vendor.
Assert that the vendor screen exposes the Best Price label.
Assert that the displayed current best price matches the lower bid submitted in the setup.
